actionTitle.description: Toolbar button tooltip before a tab has reported its state.

appDescription.message: Blurs images, CSS background images and videos on every page you visit.
appDescription.description: Store listing summary, shown under the extension name.

appName.description: Extension name, shown in the browser and on the store listing.

badgeOff.description: Toolbar badge text when nothing is being blurred. Keep it to three characters.

commandPauseTab.message: Reveal images on this tab until it is reloaded
commandPauseTab.description: Keyboard shortcut label on the browser shortcuts page.

commandToggleBlur.message: Turn image blurring on or off
commandToggleBlur.description: Keyboard shortcut label on the browser shortcuts page.

optionsBackupError.message: That file does not hold Image Blur settings.
optionsBackupError.description: Shown when an imported file cannot be read as settings.

optionsBackupExport.description: Button that saves the settings to a file.

optionsBackupHeading.description: Heading of the export and import card.

optionsBackupImport.description: Button that reads settings back from a file.

optionsBackupNote.message: Keep a copy of every setting, or carry it to another computer. The file is plain JSON and nothing in it leaves this browser.
optionsBackupNote.description: Explanation of the export and import buttons.

optionsBlurLabel.message: Radius applied to every blurred element
optionsBlurLabel.description: Label for the blur radius slider.

optionsEffectBlackout.description: Effect that blurs the image and then drops it to black.

optionsEffectBlur.description: Effect that softens the image but keeps its colours.

optionsEffectHeading.description: Section heading for the effect picker.

optionsEffectNote.message: Blur softens the image and keeps its colours; blackout blurs it and then drops it to black, which leaves nothing to read at any strength.
optionsEffectNote.description: Explains the difference between the two effects.

optionsHoverDelayLabel.description: Label for the hover delay field.

optionsHoverDelayNote.message: Stops a pointer that is only passing through from uncovering anything. The blur always comes back the moment the pointer leaves.
optionsHoverDelayNote.description: Explains why the reveal is delayed.

optionsHoverLabel.message: Show an image sharply while the pointer is over it
optionsHoverLabel.description: Label for the reveal on hover checkbox.

optionsHoverNote.message: When this is off, blurred media stays blurred no matter where the pointer goes.
optionsHoverNote.description: Explains what turning hover reveal off does.

optionsIntro.message: Images, CSS background images and videos are blurred while text, buttons and layout stay sharp. Every setting below applies everywhere the blur is on.
optionsIntro.description: Introduction at the top of the options page.

optionsMinImageLabel.message: Images, videos, canvases and background images
optionsMinImageLabel.description: Label for the raster media size limit.

optionsMinVectorHint.message: most sites draw their interface icons this way
optionsMinVectorHint.description: Why inline SVG gets a size limit of its own.

optionsMinVectorLabel.description: Label for the inline SVG size limit.

optionsReset.description: Button that puts every setting back to its default.

optionsResetConfirm.message: Reset every Image Blur setting to its default?
optionsResetConfirm.description: Confirmation asked before settings are reset.

optionsRevealKeyAlt.description: Menu choice naming the Alt key, called Option on a Mac keyboard.

optionsRevealKeyCtrl.description: Menu choice naming the Control key.

optionsRevealKeyLabel.description: Label of the menu choosing a key that hovering also requires.

optionsRevealKeyNone.description: Menu choice: hovering alone reveals an image, with no key held.

optionsRevealKeyNote.message: With a key chosen the pointer uncovers nothing by itself, which is what makes a blur survive somebody else looking at the screen. Only the key itself is watched, never what you type.
optionsRevealKeyNote.description: Explains why a reveal key is worth setting, and that nothing typed is read.

optionsRevealKeyShift.description: Menu choice naming the Shift key.

optionsSitesAdd.description: Button that adds the typed host to the exception list.

optionsSitesEmpty.description: Shown when the site list is empty.

optionsSitesError.message: Enter a host name such as example.com
optionsSitesError.description: Shown when the typed text is not a usable host name.

optionsSitesHeading.description: Heading of the site list card on the options page.

optionsSitesInputLabel.description: Accessible name of the box where a host is typed; a placeholder alone does not name a field.

optionsSitesInputLabelOnly.description: Accessible name of the host field while the list names the sites to blur.

optionsSitesModeExceptions.description: Site list mode: the list names the sites to leave alone.

optionsSitesModeLabel.description: Label of the select that decides whether the list names sites to skip or sites to blur.

optionsSitesModeOnly.description: Site list mode: the list names the only sites to blur.

optionsSitesNote.message: Nothing is blurred on these hosts. A host also covers its sub domains, so example.com covers images.example.com.
optionsSitesNote.description: Explains that the exception list matches sub domains too.

optionsSitesNoteOnly.message: Only these hosts are blurred; every other site is left alone. A host also covers its sub domains, so example.com covers images.example.com.
optionsSitesNoteOnly.description: Explanation shown under the site list while it names the sites to blur.

optionsSitesPlaceholder.description: Placeholder in the box where a host is typed.

optionsSitesRemove.description: Button that takes one host off the exception list.

optionsSitesRemoveLabel.description: Screen reader label for the remove button of one host.

optionsSizeNote.message: Anything smaller than its limit in both directions is left sharp. Set a limit to 0 to blur every size.
optionsSizeNote.description: Explains how the size limits are applied.

optionsTypeBackgrounds.description: Checkbox label: pictures a stylesheet puts behind an element.

optionsTypeCanvases.description: Checkbox label: anything a page paints itself on a <canvas> element.

optionsTypeCanvasesHint.message: charts, maps and entire apps are drawn on one, and blurring it blurs all of them
optionsTypeCanvasesHint.description: Warning after the canvas label, continuing the sentence after a dash.

optionsTypeImages.description: Checkbox label: photographs and pictures, the element.

optionsTypeVectors.description: Checkbox label: drawings written into the page as SVG markup.

optionsTypeVideos.description: Checkbox label: video players and their preview frames.

optionsTypesHeading.description: Heading of the section that turns whole kinds of media on and off.

optionsTypesNone.message: Nothing is left to blur, so nothing is blurred anywhere.
optionsTypesNone.description: Warning shown when every kind of media has been switched off.

optionsTypesNote.message: Anything switched off here is left exactly as the page drew it.
optionsTypesNote.description: Explains what turning a kind of media off does.

popupBlurStrength.description: Label above the blur radius slider.

popupOpenOptions.description: Link at the bottom of the popup that opens the options page.

popupPause.description: Button that reveals everything on the current tab.

popupPauseNote.message: Until the tab is reloaded. Shortcut: Alt+Shift+P
popupPauseNote.description: Explains how long a pause lasts.

popupResume.description: Button shown once the current tab is already paused.

popupSiteToggleTitle.description: Tooltip on the per site switch.

popupStateListed.message: Blurring images on the listed sites
popupStateListed.description: Popup subtitle while the site list names the only sites to blur.

popupStateNothing.message: No kind of media is set to be blurred
popupStateNothing.description: Popup subtitle when blurring is on but every kind of media is switched off.

popupStateOff.description: Popup subtitle while the master switch is off.

popupStateOn.description: Popup subtitle while the master switch is on.

popupThisSite.description: Label next to the host name of the tab in front of the user.

popupToggleTitle.description: Tooltip on the popup master switch.

popupUnavailable.message: Image Blur cannot run on this page.
popupUnavailable.description: Shown on pages where extensions are not allowed, such as the new tab page.

statusExported.description: Status line after writing the settings file.

statusImported.description: Status line after reading a settings file back.

statusReset.description: Shown after every setting has been put back to its default.

statusSaveFailed.description: Shown when writing a setting failed.

statusSaved.description: Shown briefly after a setting is stored.

statusSiteAdded.description: Shown after a host joins the exception list.

statusSiteDuplicate.description: Shown when the typed host is already on the list.

statusSiteRemoved.description: Shown after a host leaves the exception list.

tooltipBlurring.description: Toolbar tooltip when the extension is working normally.

tooltipNothingToBlur.message: Image Blur - no kind of media is set to be blurred
tooltipNothingToBlur.description: Toolbar button tooltip when blurring is on but every kind of media is switched off.

tooltipPausedTab.message: Image Blur - paused on this tab
tooltipPausedTab.description: Toolbar tooltip when this tab is temporarily paused.

tooltipTabOff.message: Image Blur - not blurring this tab
tooltipTabOff.description: Toolbar tooltip when this host is on the exception list.

tooltipTurnedOff.description: Toolbar tooltip when the master switch is off.

unitPixels.description: A length in pixels, such as 12 px.
